abilities.name: Divine Aid (3/Day) (Bonus Action)
abilities.description: Halric casts *Bless*, *Dispel Magic*, *Healing Word*, or *Lesser Restoration*, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Halric makes two attacks: one with Mace and one with Radiant Flame. It can replace one attack with a use of Scalding Chain.

actions.name: Mace
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Flame
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d10) radiant damage.

actions.name: Scalding Chain
actions.description: Each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
Halric casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13): - **At will:** *Light*, *Thaumaturgy*
**1/day each:** *Spirit Guardians*
